Problem.description: An RFC 9457 Problem Details object. code is one of: 401 unauthenticated; 403 access_denied; 404 not_found; 409 conflict; 422 validation_error; 422 user_error; 422 invalid_request; 500 internal_error. See /docs/api/errors for what each means.

Context.description: Context for the call, such as lang, tz and allowed_company_ids.

instance.description: An opaque id for this occurrence; present on 5xx only.

type.description: A reference to the error code's entry on /docs/api/errors.

Ids.description: Record ids the method is called on.

body.description: Additional message that would be sent with the notification for the reminder
body.title: Additional Message

mail_template_id.description: Template used to render mail reminder content.
mail_template_id.title: Email Template

sms_template_id.description: Template used to render SMS reminder content.
sms_template_id.title: SMS Template

mail_tz.description: Timezone used for displaying time in the mail template
mail_tz.title: Mail Tz

active.description: If the active field is set to false, it will allow you to hide the event alarm information without removing it.
active.title: Active

alarm_ids.description: Notifications sent to all attendees to remind of the meeting.
alarm_ids.title: Reminders

description.description: When synchronization with an external calendar is active, this description is synchronized         with the one of the associated meeting in that external calendar. Any update will be propagated there         and vice versa.
description.title: Description

effective_privacy.description: Whether the event is private, considering the user privacy
effective_privacy.title: Effective Privacy

is_organizer_alone.description:
Check if the organizer is alone in the event, i.e. if the organizer is the only one that hasn't declined
        the event (only if the organizer is not the only attendee)
is_organizer_alone.title: Is the Organizer Alone

message_has_error.description: If checked, some messages have a delivery error.
message_has_error.title: Message Delivery error

message_has_error_counter.description: Number of messages with delivery error
message_has_error_counter.title: Number of errors

message_has_sms_error.description: If checked, some messages have a delivery error.
message_has_sms_error.title: SMS Delivery error

message_needaction.description: If checked, new messages require your attention.
message_needaction.title: Action Needed

privacy.description: People to whom this event will be visible.
privacy.title: Privacy

recurrence_update.description: Choose what to do with other events in the recurrence. Updating All Events is not allowed when dates or time is modified
recurrence_update.title: Recurrence Update

rrule_type.description: Let the event automatically repeat at that interval
rrule_type.title: Recurrence

rrule_type_ui.description: Let the event automatically repeat at that interval
rrule_type_ui.title: Repeat

show_as.description:
If the time is shown as 'busy', this event will be visible to other people with either the full         information or simply 'busy' written depending on its privacy. Use this option to let other people know         that you are unavailable during that period of time. 
 If the event is shown as 'free', other users know         that you are available during that period of time.
show_as.title: Show as

start.description: Start date of an event, without time for full days events
start.title: Start

stop.description: Stop date of an event, without time for full days events
stop.title: Stop

info.description: Every model and method reachable over POST /json/2/<model>/<method>. Generated from the running system for the signed-in user, so it shows only what that user may read.
info.title: AFENDA xForge JSON API
